role_seal.structural_fields_readable_for_all: existing structural JSONL only (one target point per trial, block/trial indices, electrode identity)

packet.session_nodes: capable sessions of the participant's registered passing P0 component (T11: 64; T9: 59)
packet.schedule: P0 classification recomputed with code/apply_source_fact_support.py (load_session, classify_session, session_nodes)
eligibility_in_order: whole trial inside its declared block
block is one of the node's kept schedule blocks
stored target is not a P0 placeholder target
30-bin window [start, start+30) lies inside the block's sample range (trial end is not used)
cursor and stored target at the window start are finite
distance(cursor_start, stored_target_start) > 0.05 * median nonzero pairwise distance of the session's canonical P0 layout (native coordinates); equality excludes
packet.label: unit vector from cursor_start to stored target at window start (native coordinates)
packet.slot_of_trial: P0 intended-target slot of the stored target (C or direction 0-7)
packet.center_configuration_signature: per block, the sorted tuple of distinct stored coordinates of its center-slot targets (T11 alternates x=0.0012 and x=0.0025)

sides.unit: whole blocks; every kept block is assigned to side A or B; A contains the earliest kept block
sides.side_packet: first 64 eligible trials of the side in time order; nested fitting subsets are its first 16 and 32 trials
sides.search: exhaustive over all 2-colourings of kept blocks (at most 2^(K-1); K<=10 observed)
hard_constraints: each 64-trial side packet contains every canonical slot
each 64-trial side packet contains all 8 label octants
preferences_lexicographic: both first-32 subsets contain all 8 octants

smallest total-variation distance between the two 64-packets' center-configuration compositions (T11 decision: balance configurations where whole blocks allow; otherwise keep the configurations as observed)
both first-16 subsets contain all 8 octants
lexicographically smallest sorted tuple of side-A block ids
sides.folds: fold 1 fits side A and evaluates side B; fold 2 reverses
sides.no_feasible_colouring: session is packet-unresolved and removed with all its pairs before any neural score is computed; the realized design is re-gated

packet.realized_design_gate: after packet failures, the remaining chronological near/long design must pass the unchanged schedule_support.json component gates (rank, condition < 100, residual L2 > 0.10, retained energy > 0.10, node share < 0.25); failure makes the participant unresolved
packet.configuration_sensitivity: repeat decisive contrasts on sessions whose two packets have one shared configuration composition; reported, cannot rescue

features.window: analysis_definition.feature_window (mean only if all 30 bins finite; else missing channel feature)
features.physical_axis: sorted union of (array label, Utah-grid x, y) over the participant's realized sessions; electrode_id is a per-file column number (T11 day 1549 lists the medial array as ids 0-95, the other 63 sessions the lateral array), so it is not used as identity; every T11 and T9 session has 192 unique grid keys
features.scaling: analysis_definition.channel_quality (fit on the model's own fitting trials, ddof 0, inactive or missing -> 0 in fitting coordinates)

validity.dead_channel: per session over its 128 packet trials: SD (ddof 0) <= 1e-6 x the session's median channel SD -> every window of that channel invalid (missing); T11: two sessions with one dead 96-channel array
validity.sbp_artifact: per session and channel over the 128 packet trials: windows strictly above 10x the channel's median over its currently valid windows are missing, iterated until the artifact mask stabilizes (fixed point, at most 50 passes; nonfinite or nonpositive medians -> no removal); the same per-channel threshold applies to every trial of the session in block normalization; a missing channel feature, never a deleted trial
validity.reason: attempt t11_calibration01 failed numerically before any interpretable score: mismatched electrode keys (384-channel axis), a dead array with SD ~1e-25 and sbp artifacts up to 1e7 uV^2 produced J = -36,849 and lambda at the grid maximum
validity.fence_change: 2026-10-17: replaces a single 10x-pre-artifact-median fence after the independent review found the block path applying a second, stricter pass; the single pass let frequent artifacts inflate the median (T11 day 444 J fell to -0.71). Noticed through a T11 local score, so disclosed as post hoc; the rule itself uses no labels or scores

features.normalization: block (proposed primary, pending the scientist; see proposed_pending_scientist); frozen source-only scaling is the fallback and a required sensitivity

ridge.objective: sum_i w_i ||y_i - c - z_i beta||^2 + lambda ||beta||^2 with octant weights w summing to 1 on the fitting labels; intercept unpenalized
ridge.lambda_rule: one global lambda per feature, chosen on T11: maximize the mean over realized T11 sessions of fold-averaged L_t(64) on the grid 10^(-2.0..3.0 step 0.25); ties -> larger lambda; an edge maximum extends the grid one decade once
ridge.same_lambda_for: source, target-local, learning-curve (16/32/64), emulated-local, survivor and adaptation reference fits

models.null: octant-weighted mean of the fitting labels (intercept only)
models.scores: B_t, L_t(n), F_st, A_st(n) are fold-averaged before any difference or ratio

readiness.J_min_rule: 0.99 quantile (numpy 'higher') of pooled T11 within-block label-permutation null J (labels permuted within each block of the fitting packet, 3 seeded permutations per session, scored on true evaluation labels), rounded up to 0.01, floor 0.01
readiness.target_readiness: every target in a primary pair needs J_t = L_t(64) - B_t > J_min, else the pair and component are unresolved
readiness.source_readiness: every source in a local-signal pair needs J_s > J_min
readiness.raw_gap_minimum_D_min: equal to J_min; applied to the aggregate long-gap transport gap of the repair statistic
readiness.superseded_rule: block-preserving circular shifts by 1/4, 1/2, 3/4 of the block (T11 q99 0.12): replaced at 2026-10-17T01:19:55Z after calibration03 because shifts alias the centre-out-back label sequence (a one-trial shift maps each outward label onto its exact opposite; cycle-length shifts can reproduce labels). Post hoc correction after seeing T11 J values; the shifted-label null stays a reported control

estimands.adjusted: WLS coefficient on the long indicator; schedule_support.json weights and Helmert nuisance
estimands.robust: median over sources within target and lag, median over targets within lag, long minus near
estimands.fractional_local: target-equal weights within lag (split over sources) of (J_t - J_s)/J_s, long minus near
estimands.raw_transported: same weights of F_st - B_t, long minus near
estimands.aggregation: one schedule group and one component for T11 and T9; the general rule is equal group then equal component

uncertainty.session_level: draw N session occurrences with replacement from the N realized nodes; each occurrence is a distinct node; rebuild every chronological near/long pair between occurrences of different sessions
uncertainty.within_occurrence: evaluation trials resampled with replacement within (side, block, octant) strata at fixed positions; every model (source, local, null, adaptation, emulator) stays fit once to the occurrence's realized fitting trials; whole blocks are kept as strata and never split across sides
uncertainty.block_unit_resampling_not_used: a 64-trial side has 1-4 blocks, often partial; drawing blocks as units changes packet size and empties octants or slots, making draws nonestimable for reasons unrelated to the estimand; between-block variation is carried by the session-level draw. Reported as a disclosed interpretation of 'resample whole blocks and trials'
uncertainty.nonestimable: rank loss or any readiness failure -> -inf for lower and +inf for upper bounds; never redrawn
uncertainty.bounds: one-sided percentile order statistics: k = alpha_each*(draws+1)
uncertainty.fitting_trials_not_resampled: refitting ridge models (n=64 < p) on duplicated resampled fitting trials biased bootstrap J by -0.044 (SD 0.052) on synthetic data and made 40% of draws nonestimable for sessions with J near 0.2 (runs/analysis_specification/20261016-synthetic_checks01); fitting variability is carried by the session-level draw
uncertainty.implementation: per-position evaluation losses computed once; each draw is an index-and-sum (code/ep16_panel.py Realization)

extra_long_gap_loss.supported: lower bounds of adjusted and robust > 0.10
extra_long_gap_loss.unresolved: infinite bound, realized-design gate failure, or observed nonestimable

local_signal_reduction.supported: upper bounds of fractional < -0.15 and raw < raw_score_decline_margin
local_signal_reduction.weakened: either finite upper bound >= its margin

recording_sufficiency.supported: upper bound of identity max reproduction error < 0.10 and lower bound of (random - identity) max error > 0.05, with >= 6 near and >= 6 long eligible no-better transitions
recording_sufficiency.unresolved: fewer transitions, rank loss, infinite bound

repair_32.supported: lower bounds of recovery fraction > 0.50 and relative gain > 0.10
repair_32.unresolved: aggregate D or J readiness failure, infinite bound

decision_rules.null_interpretation: an extra-loss or local-signal 'not established/weakened' result is interpreted only if that account's known-positive check passes on T9's design; otherwise reported as underidentified
decision_rules.conclusion_map: code/ep16_panel.py conclusion(); exhaustively tested over all decision-state combinations

recording_emulator.inputs: fitting-side summaries only: declared electrode availability, complete-window rate per channel, per-channel variance of source-standardized features (ddof 0); no labels, cursor, scores or decoder weights
recording_emulator.eligible_transitions: analysis_definition direct no-better order in both folds; incomparable and fold-discordant transitions are controls

families.E1_dropout: target-unavailable or source-inactive channels -> 0; channels with r_t < r_s are masked per trial with probability (r_s - r_t)/r_s
families.E2_dropout_noise_theta0: E1 plus minimal-change variance match v_j: v_j<1 -> attenuation a=sqrt(v_j); v_j>=1 -> added Gaussian noise sigma^2=v_j-1
families.E2_dropout_noise_theta0.5: compatible alternative: a^2 = 0.5*min(v_j,1), sigma^2 = v_j - a^2 (same marginal variance; sensitivity)
families.E2_dropout_noise_theta0_floor: E2 theta0 with variance ratios inside their 95% sampling band, |log v| <= 1.96*sqrt(2/(n_s-1)+2/(n_t-1)), treated as unchanged; added after the stationary synthetic check showed unfloored matching emulates sampling noise as degradation (null long-local error -0.054 vs -0.022 floored)

recording_emulator.constraints: 0 <= a <= 1, sigma^2 >= 0; no invented channel; transform fitted on fitting sides and reused unchanged on evaluation trials
recording_emulator.scores: emulated-local ridge fit on transformed S_k, clean source ridge and emulated-local evaluated on transformed S_not_k; source labels and source null
recording_emulator.matched_random: jointly permute (drop, mask rate, a, sigma) across channels within (array, source complete-rate tertile) strata; 20 seeded permutations; scores averaged over permutations
recording_emulator.reproduction_errors: absolute errors in near and long weighted local change, near and long weighted loss R, and the adjusted extra-loss contrast, on the same eligible transition graph; statistic = their maximum
recording_emulator.decision: see decision_rules.recording_sufficiency; extra-loss reproduction margin 0.10 (folded into the maximum), separation margin 0.05
recording_emulator.selection: development search chooses one of E1_dropout, E2_theta0, E2_theta0_floor by recording-summary fit, stability and complexity, never by decoding reproduction; theta 0.5 is a sensitivity

recalibration.exposure: first n trials of the target fitting side, n in {16, 32, 64}; evaluation trials never tune

unlabelled.past_only: For H in {16, 64}, restandardize each evaluation trial using the H most recent packet trials preceding it in time, requiring at least max(2, H//2) finite history values per channel and a finite positive SD; otherwise use source-scaling fallback. When normalization is block, label these results history_restricted_restandardization_of_block_normalized_features_not_literal_past_only.
unlabelled.covariance: Bounded CORAL uses source fitting trials and the first 32 target fitting trials with alpha in {0.5, 0.9}; singular values (operator gains) of A are clipped to [1/3, 3].
unlabelled.subspace: top-8 principal subspace alignment (Procrustes between bases)

supervised.low_rank: beta + U_r Gamma, U_r = top-r unlabelled principal directions of the n target trials, r in {2, 4}, ridge on Gamma with the global lambda
supervised.bounded_supervised: argmin weighted loss + lambda_b ||beta' - beta_s||^2, lambda_b the smallest grid value with effective df <= n/2

limits.operator_bounds: gains, scale and covariance eigenvalues clipped to [1/3, 3]

recalibration.shuffled_label_control: every supervised method refit on labels permuted within the n fitting trials (seeded)

recovery.population: long-gap chronological pairs whose target has octant-complete first-32 fitting subsets on both sides (pre-score label support; frozen octant rule leaves other 32-label packets unresolved); excluded long pairs are counted; fewer than 6 eligible long pairs -> unresolved; near-gap reported descriptively
recovery.aggregation: ratio of target-equal weighted sums: recovery = sum wG(32)/sum wD, gain = sum wG(32)/sum wJ_t, G = A(32) - F, D = L(64) - F
recovery.readiness: sum wD > D_min and every J_t > J_min

known_positive_control.purpose: show the frozen pipeline resolves a known long-gap-only effect one margin beyond each decision margin within the participant's real session structure

extra_loss_injection.where: long-gap pairs only, transported features only
extra_loss_injection.mechanism: i.i.d. Gaussian noise added to source-standardized target evaluation features seen by the source mapping, variance sigma^2 = 0.20 * J_t / ||beta_s,k||_F^2 fixed from the observed data, so E[R increase] = 0.20; noise fixed per (source, target, fold, packet position)

local_signal_injection.where: long-gap pairs only (degraded copy of the target used only in long pairs)
local_signal_injection.mechanism: Gaussian noise in target fitting-standardized units added to both target sides, level found by bisection on the observed data so the target's long-pair weighted fractional change falls by 0.30

pass_rule.extra_loss: for adjusted and robust: lower_bound(injected run) - observed_point > 0.10 and |injected_point - observed_point - 0.20| <= 0.05
pass_rule.local_signal: upper_bound(injected fractional) - observed_point < -0.15, upper_bound(injected raw) - observed raw point < raw_score_decline_margin, and |injected_point - observed_point + 0.30| <= 0.05
pass_rule.bounds: primary family level (alpha 0.0125 each), 9,999 draws, same nonestimable rule

known_positive_control.t9: same injections calibrated on T9's observed data inside the sealed evaluation

values_from_T11.conditional_on: block normalization (proposed primary) and the fixed-point sbp artifact fence

interpretation_notes.adjusted_contrast_scope: the frozen adjusted contrast is the long-gap step beyond additive source and target session effects; any loss additive in sessions, including one linear in elapsed days (R = k*(day_t - day_s)), is absorbed into session effects. Synthetic monotone drift gave adjusted -0.35 with robust +0.33. A smooth drift therefore cannot by itself establish extra long-gap loss (both contrasts must clear 0.10); the known-positive injection is a pure long-gap step and is recovered exactly
interpretation_notes.raw_transported_contrast_scope: the raw contrast compares long-target and near-target levels of F - B; when near pairs span the whole timeline a monotone decline lowers both, so the raw criterion is less sensitive than the fractional one
interpretation_notes.recording_separation_power: synthetic identity-specific dropout (12 of the 12 strongest of 48 channels, 24 sessions) reproduced within 0.10 but the separation lower bound was 0.008 (point 0.069); 16 strongest dropped with 48 sessions gave 0.038. The 0.05 separation margin is unchanged and demanding; this is a power finding, recorded for the scientist

proposed_pending_scientist.block_normalization: PROPOSED PRIMARY, needs the scientist: z-score each channel within each block using that block's eligible trials (provider convention). With the frozen source-only scaling T11 local J has median 0.027 at the calibrated lambda 178 (25/64 sessions <= 0.02; best of lambda 10/100/1000 per session: median 0.069) because sbp baselines shift between blocks; with block normalization median 0.41. Block normalization uses each evaluation block's own unlabelled statistics and removes baseline drift from transport, which changes what F measures; the frozen scaling is kept as a sensitivity
proposed_pending_scientist.readiness_rule: NEEDS THE SCIENTIST: under the frozen rule any target with J <= J_min leaves the component unresolved. T11 has sessions with no local signal (J = -0.056, 0.001, 0.037, 0.045 under block normalization), so T11 is unresolved for any J_min, and T9 likely too. Option: remove sessions with observed J <= J_min as nodes before pairing, re-gate the realized design, disclose the count and report the strict rule as a sensitivity (diagnostic run on T11 in calibration04)
proposed_pending_scientist.uncertainty_within_occurrence: NEEDS THE SCIENTIST (independent review): resampling only evaluation trials, with fits fixed, departs from the policy text 'resample whole blocks and trials within each occurrence' and changes what the bounds condition on. Refitting n=64 ridge models on duplicated trials biased J by -0.044 on synthetic data and made draws nonestimable
proposed_pending_scientist.readiness_null: NEEDS THE SCIENTIST with the readiness rule: J_min from a within-block permutation null (0.07) replaced the circular-shift null (0.13) after T11 J values were seen; the shift null aliases the centre-out-back label sequence
